summary: Frontend mobile retest completed: login loads at 375px without horizontal overflow, local validation and login/registro toggle work, and invalid Supabase credentials now return Invalid login credentials instead of Failed to fetch.
action_items: Provide a valid test account or seed a non-production test account before dashboard/session, pairing, controls, tabs and sign-out flows can be verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard CRUD/realtime flows remain unverified because no credentials are available; load() does not surface Supabase query errors to the UI, so authenticated data failures could appear as an empty state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit/auth-toggle/auth-name are usable. Empty submit shows local validation. Using invalid-timeguard@outlook.com/wrongpass in login mode reaches Supabase and renders Invalid login credentials. Dashboard-dependent testIDs and flows were not exercised due to missing credentials.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 1's Failed to fetch regression is resolved in the preview: Supabase URL/key are now exposed through EXPO_PUBLIC_* fallback and app.json extra, and the browser receives the expected auth error response. A syntactically valid non-account email was used only for negative testing; no account or seed data was created.
